name: meal-planner
description: Plan safe household meals with verified recipes and bounded grocery work; maintain canonical recipes, feedback, and half-step ratings.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and track meals, recipes, groceries, and costs
interface.longDescription: Review previously made meals before planning, maintain formatted Drive-native household and recipe records with verified named links, preserve records during cleanup or migration, and coordinate safe plans with full shopper-backed groceries or a bounded local grocery fallback.
defaultPrompt: Plan a safe week of dinners for my household.
Find recipes that fit my preferences and constraints.
Turn these recipes into a priced grocery list.
